summary.text: Andrea Campbell is the incumbent Democratic Attorney General of Massachusetts, seeking a second term. A former Boston City Council president, she was elected attorney general in 2022 and has used the office to sue the Trump administration, enforce the MBTA Communities housing law and bring wage, consumer and landlord cases.

paragraphs.text: Raised in Roxbury and the South End of Boston; graduated from Boston Latin School, Princeton University and UCLA Law School.

Worked as a legal services attorney for children with disabilities and as legal counsel to Governor Deval Patrick before winning a seat on the Boston City Council, where she later served as council president.
Elected Attorney General of Massachusetts in 2022.
